     2	
     3	## Overview
     4	This collection of datasets captures the global epidemiological transition between 1990 and 2024, covering top causes of disability-adjusted life years (DALYs), disease burden composition by World Bank income group, and aggregate category totals.
     5	
     6	## Data Source
     7	
     8	### top10_daly_causes
     9	Contains 20 rows (10 per year). Fields: `year` (1990 or 2024), `rank` (1–10), `cause` (disease/condition name, string), `dalys_millions` (float, millions of DALYs), `category` (one of: Communicable, NCD, Injury). Represents the top 10 global DALY causes for each reference year.
    10	
    11	### daly_by_income_group
    12	Contains 8 rows (4 income groups × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `income_group` (Low income, Lower-middle income, Upper-middle income, High income), `communicable_pct`, `ncd_pct`, `injury_pct` — each a float summing to approximately 100% per row. Represents percentage share of total DALYs by disease category within each income group.
    13	
    14	### global_category_totals
    15	Contains 6 rows (3 categories × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `category` (Communicable, NCD, Injury), `dalys_millions` (float). Represents aggregate global DALYs by broad disease category.
    16	
    17	## Data Notes
    18	- DALY estimates are modeled based on GBD-style methodology; 2024 figures are projected estimates.
    19	- Communicable category includes maternal, neonatal, and nutritional conditions per GBD convention.
    20	- Percentages may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.

import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

top10 = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']
income = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']
global_totals = data['global_category_totals']['data']

# Color scheme: editorial, authoritative
COLOR_COMM = '#D9534F'   # warm red for communicable
COLOR_NCD = '#337AB7'    # deep blue for NCD
COLOR_INJ = '#F0AD4E'    # amber for injuries
COLOR_BG = '#FAFAFA'
COLOR_GRID = '#E0E0E0'
COLOR_TEXT = '#333333'
COLOR_LIGHT_TEXT = '#666666'

# Prepare data structures
top10_1990 = [r for r in top10 if r['year'] == 1990]
top10_2024 = [r for r in top10 if r['year'] == 2024]

income_1990 = [r for r in income if r['year'] == 1990]
income_2024 = [r for r in income if r['year'] == 2024]

global_1990 = {r['category']: r['dalys_millions'] for r in global_totals if r['year'] == 1990}
global_2024 = {r['category']: r['dalys_millions'] for r in global_totals if r['year'] == 2024}

# Create figure with 3 subplots in a column
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 20), facecolor=COLOR_BG)
fig.suptitle(
    'Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 vs 2024',
    fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_TEXT, y=0.98
)
fig.text(
    0.5, 0.955,
    'DALY = Disability-Adjusted Life Years  |  Source: GBD-style modeled estimates',
    ha='center', fontsize=11, color=COLOR_LIGHT_TEXT, style='italic'
)

# Layout: 3 rows, 1 column with different heights
# Row 1: Global category totals (bar chart)
# Row 2: Income group disparity (grouped stacked bars)
# Row 3: Top 10 cause rank changes (slope chart / dumbbell)

gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 1, hspace=0.28, left=0.08, right=0.92, top=0.93, bottom=0.04)

# ============================================
# Panel 1: Global Aggregate DALYs by Category
# ============================================
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax1.set_facecolor(COLOR_BG)

categories = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']
x = np.arange(len(categories))
width = 0.35

vals_1990 = [global_1990[c] for c in categories]
vals_2024 = [global_2024[c] for c in categories]

bars1 = ax1.bar(x - width/2, vals_1990, width, label='1990', color=[COLOR_COMM, COLOR_NCD, COLOR_INJ], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.85)
bars2 = ax1.bar(x + width/2, vals_2024, width, label='2024', color=[COLOR_COMM, COLOR_NCD, COLOR_INJ], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, alpha=1.0)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.annotate(f'{height:.1f}M',
                xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                xytext=(0, 4), textcoords="offset points",
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, color=COLOR_LIGHT_TEXT, fontweight='bold')
for bar in bars2:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.annotate(f'{height:.1f}M',
                xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                xytext=(0, 4), textcoords="offset points",
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, color=COLOR_TEXT, fontweight='bold')

ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)', fontsize=12, color=COLOR_TEXT)
ax1.set_title('Global Aggregate DALYs by Disease Category', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_TEXT, pad=12)
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['Communicable Diseases', 'Non-Communicable Diseases', 'Injuries'], fontsize=11, color=COLOR_TEXT)
ax1.legend(title='Year', loc='upper left', frameon=True, fancybox=False, edgecolor=COLOR_GRID)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['left'].set_color(COLOR_GRID)
ax1.spines['bottom'].set_color(COLOR_GRID)
ax1.tick_params(colors=COLOR_TEXT)
ax1.set_ylim(0, max(vals_2024)*1.15)
ax1.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, color=COLOR_GRID)
ax1.set_axisbelow(True)

# Add annotation about structural transition
ax1.annotate(
    'NCD burden nearly doubled\nwhile communicable burden\nfell by 46%',
    xy=(1 + width/2, global_2024['NCD']), xytext=(1.6, 1300),
    fontsize=10, color=COLOR_NCD, fontweight='bold',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLOR_NCD, lw=1.2),
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=COLOR_NCD, alpha=0.9)
)

# ============================================
# Panel 2: Income Group Disparity (stacked bars)
# ============================================
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax2.set_facecolor(COLOR_BG)

income_groups = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
comm_1990 = [r['communicable_pct'] for r in income_1990]
ncd_1990 = [r['ncd_pct'] for r in income_1990]
inj_1990 = [r['injury_pct'] for r in income_1990]
comm_2024 = [r['communicable_pct'] for r in income_2024]
ncd_2024 = [r['ncd_pct'] for r in income_2024]
inj_2024 = [r['injury_pct'] for r in income_2024]

x = np.arange(len(income_groups))
width = 0.35

# 1990 stacked bars
ax2.bar(x - width/2, comm_1990, width, label='Communicable', color=COLOR_COMM, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.85)
ax2.bar(x - width/2, ncd_1990, width, bottom=comm_1990, label='NCD', color=COLOR_NCD, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.85)
ax2.bar(x - width/2, inj_1990, width, bottom=[c+n for c,n in zip(comm_1990, ncd_1990)], label='Injury', color=COLOR_INJ, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.85)

# 2024 stacked bars
ax2.bar(x + width/2, comm_2024, width, color=COLOR_COMM, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=1.0)
ax2.bar(x + width/2, ncd_2024, width, bottom=comm_2024, color=COLOR_NCD, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=1.0)
ax2.bar(x + width/2, inj_2024, width, bottom=[c+n for c,n in zip(comm_2024, ncd_2024)], color=COLOR_INJ, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=1.0)

# Add percentage labels inside bars for key segments
for i, (c1, n1, c2, n2) in enumerate(zip(comm_1990, ncd_1990, comm_2024, ncd_2024)):
    # 1990 labels
    ax2.text(i - width/2, c1/2, f'{c1:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='white', fontweight='bold')
    ax2.text(i - width/2, c1 + n1/2, f'{n1:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='white', fontweight='bold')
    # 2024 labels
    ax2.text(i + width/2, c2/2, f'{c2:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='white', fontweight='bold')
    ax2.text(i + width/2, c2 + n2/2, f'{n2:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='white', fontweight='bold')

ax2.set_ylabel('Share of total DALYs (%)', fontsize=12, color=COLOR_TEXT)
ax2.set_title('Disease Burden Composition by World Bank Income Group', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_TEXT, pad=12)
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(income_groups, fontsize=11, color=COLOR_TEXT)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['left'].set_color(COLOR_GRID)
ax2.spines['bottom'].set_color(COLOR_GRID)
ax2.tick_params(colors=COLOR_TEXT)
ax2.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, color=COLOR_GRID)
ax2.set_axisbelow(True)

# Custom legend
legend_patches = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLOR_COMM, label='Communicable'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLOR_NCD, label='Non-Communicable (NCD)'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLOR_INJ, label='Injuries')
]
ax2.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc='upper right', frameon=True, fancybox=False, edgecolor=COLOR_GRID, title='Disease Category')

# Year labels below x-axis
for i in range(len(income_groups)):
    ax2.text(i - width/2, -6, '1990', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9, color=COLOR_LIGHT_TEXT, fontweight='bold')
    ax2.text(i + width/2, -6, '2024', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9, color=COLOR_TEXT, fontweight='bold')

# ============================================
# Panel 3: Top 10 Cause Rank Changes (slope chart)
# ============================================
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
ax3.set_facecolor(COLOR_BG)

# Get all unique causes from both years
all_causes = []
seen = set()
for r in top10_1990:
    if r['cause'] not in seen:
        all_causes.append(r['cause'])
        seen.add(r['cause'])
for r in top10_2024:
    if r['cause'] not in seen:
        all_causes.append(r['cause'])
        seen.add(r['cause'])

# Build rank maps
rank_1990 = {r['cause']: r['rank'] for r in top10_1990}
rank_2024 = {r['cause']: r['rank'] for r in top10_2024}
cat_1990 = {r['cause']: r['category'] for r in top10_1990}
cat_2024 = {r['cause']: r['category'] for r in top10_2024}
dalys_1990 = {r['cause']: r['dalys_millions'] for r in top10_1990}
dalys_2024 = {r['cause']: r['dalys_millions'] for r in top10_2024}

def get_color(cause):
    cat = cat_2024.get(cause, cat_1990.get(cause, 'NCD'))
    if cat == 'Communicable':
        return COLOR_COMM
    elif cat == 'NCD':
        return COLOR_NCD
    else:
        return COLOR_INJ

# Sort causes by their average rank or by 2024 rank if available
all_causes.sort(key=lambda c: rank_2024.get(c, 20))

y_positions = {cause: i for i, cause in enumerate(all_causes)}

# Draw lines connecting 1990 to 2024 ranks
for cause in all_causes:
    r1 = rank_1990.get(cause, None)
    r2 = rank_2024.get(cause, None)
    color = get_color(cause)
    
    if r1 is not None and r2 is not None:
        # Both years present: draw connecting line
        ax3.plot([0, 1], [r1, r2], color=color, linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.7, zorder=2)
        ax3.scatter([0, 1], [r1, r2], color=color, s=120, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5)
    elif r1 is not None:
        # Only 1990
        ax3.scatter([0], [r1], color=color, s=120, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5, marker='o')
    elif r2 is not None:
        # Only 2024
        ax3.scatter([1], [r2], color=color, s=120, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5, marker='o')

# Add labels
for cause in all_causes:
    r1 = rank_1990.get(cause, None)
    r2 = rank_2024.get(cause, None)
    color = get_color(cause)
    
    if r1 is not None:
        ax3.text(-0.06, r1, f"{r1}. {cause}", ha='right', va='center', fontsize=10, color=color, fontweight='bold')
    if r2 is not None:
        ax3.text(1.06, r2, f"{r2}. {cause}", ha='left', va='center', fontsize=10, color=color, fontweight='bold')

# Add DALY values near points
for cause in all_causes:
    r1 = rank_1990.get(cause, None)
    r2 = rank_2024.get(cause, None)
    color = get_color(cause)
    if r1 is not None:
        ax3.text(-0.02, r1 + 0.35, f"{dalys_1990[cause]:.1f}M", ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=8, color=COLOR_LIGHT_TEXT)
    if r2 is not None:
        ax3.text(1.02, r2 + 0.35, f"{dalys_2024[cause]:.1f}M", ha='left', va='bottom', fontsize=8, color=COLOR_LIGHT_TEXT)

ax3.set_xlim(-0.5, 1.5)
ax3.set_ylim(11.5, 0.3)
ax3.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax3.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_TEXT)
ax3.set_title('Rank Changes of Top 10 Global DALY Causes', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_TEXT, pad=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Rank', fontsize=12, color=COLOR_TEXT)
ax3.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['bottom'].set_color(COLOR_GRID)
ax3.spines['left'].set_color(COLOR_GRID)
ax3.tick_params(colors=COLOR_TEXT)
ax3.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4, color=COLOR_GRID)
ax3.set_axisbelow(True)
ax3.set_yticks(range(1, 11))
ax3.set_yticklabels([str(i) for i in range(1, 11)], fontsize=10, color=COLOR_TEXT)

# Add legend for categories
legend_patches2 = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLOR_COMM, label='Communicable'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLOR_NCD, label='Non-Communicable (NCD)'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLOR_INJ, label='Injuries')
]
ax3.legend(handles=legend_patches2, loc='lower right', frameon=True, fancybox=False, edgecolor=COLOR_GRID, title='Disease Category')

# Add annotation for key transitions
ax3.annotate(
    'Ischemic heart disease\nrose from #4 to #1',
    xy=(0.5, 2.5), xytext=(0.75, 4.5),
    fontsize=9, color=COLOR_NCD, fontweight='bold',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLOR_NCD, lw=1.0),
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=COLOR_NCD, alpha=0.9)
)
ax3.annotate(
    'Lower respiratory infections\ndropped from #1 to #6',
    xy=(0.5, 4.5), xytext=(0.15, 2.0),
    fontsize=9, color=COLOR_COMM, fontweight='bold',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLOR_COMM, lw=1.0),
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=COLOR_COMM, alpha=0.9)
)

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, facecolor=COLOR_BG, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.3)
